title: Trump offers $1 million reward for information leading to electoral fraud conviction ahead of midterms
detail: Ahead of the November midterms, Trump promised a $1 million reward for any information leading to a conviction for electoral fraud, according to Le Monde.
confidenceReason: Single-outlet report; details of the reward program not independently confirmed.

title: Trump says he will accept midterm results if elections are 'honest', again alluding to unproven fraud
detail: Trump said he would accept the results of the November midterms if the elections are 'honest', again alluding to electoral fraud claims that have never been proven, according to Le Monde.
confidenceReason: Single-outlet report based on headline summary.
